insights: **Weekly Highlights —** RationAle Brewing delivered $4,152 in total sales for Week 45 on 240 units, versus $5,019 the prior week (-17.3% WoW). The West Coast IPA 6-Pack was the standout at $552 (+86.2%) with units up 87.5% to 45 and a 49.5% conversion rate, and the week finished strong with Saturday, Nov 7 as the peak day at $797.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Variety Pack 12-Pack remains our top seller at $2,049 but eased 21.7% as sessions dipped 22.2% to 263, while the Hazy IPA 6-Pack slipped to $437 (-33.4%) on 33.2% fewer sessions. Conversion is holding up well on both (28.5% and 29.6%), so we are focused on rebuilding traffic to these listings to bring organic sales of $2,602 (-14.0% WoW) back up.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend held steady at $1,140 (prior $1,162) and generated $1,550 in PPC revenue for a 1.36x ROAS and 73.6% ACOS, with TACoS at 27.5%. Ad conversion is healthy at 16.28% on a 0.41% ad CTR, so the opportunity is in tightening targeting and bids to lift ROAS back toward the prior week's 1.71x.

**Actions This Week —** We will trim bids on low-converting search terms and shift budget toward the West Coast IPA and Mexican Cerveza 6-Packs, which converted at 49.5% and 44.6%. We will also increase visibility for the Variety Pack and Hazy IPA to recover sessions, and test new Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.41%.
